description.text: The Japanese Gym deck of Blaine, Cinnabar Island's Gym Leader, sold as ポケモンジム第3弾「グレンタウンジム カツラ」 (Pokémon Gym 3: Guren Town Gym, Katsura) on 26 February 1999 with Sabrina's deck, the last pair of six. Its 64 cards are 25 different ones: Blaine's own Pokémon, Blaine as a holo Trainer, a holo Blaine's Arcanine, the Cinnabar City Gym stadium, new Trainers, and reworded copies of older Trainers that the decks share. The cards carry the Gym series' symbol, as Leader's Stadium's and Challenge from the Darkness's do, but no card number or rarity mark. Challenge from the Darkness reprinted many of them with a rarity mark, and English players got them in Gym Challenge; the deck was the model for the English Blaine theme deck. This pair was pitched at more experienced players than the first four decks. It has Blaine's Quiz #1 and #2, Trainers that quiz the opponent about a Pokémon in your hand. It came with a rule book and a red Arcanine coin.
